query:
INSERT INTO organization_limit_notification_events (
            organization_id,
            notification_type,
            allowance_snapshot,
            active_researched_count_snapshot
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            ($2::text)::limit_notification_type,
            $3,
            $4
         )
         ON CONFLICT (organization_id, notification_type, month_start_utc)
         DO NOTHING
         RETURNING id AS "id!: Uuid"
